wished_for: A HIPAA framework mapping or recipe listing which templates cover which HIPAA sections
An example of marking a schema field sensitive in XanoScript
A check for access logging of reads, or a template for it
A clear statement on whether db.get counts as fetching all fields
Guidance on starting from an empty tag vocabulary (which tag names to propose)
why_confidence: The drafts parse with no warnings and cover the technical gaps visible in the workspace, but HIPAA compliance is mostly process and runtime controls no check reads. Findings are predictions only; evaluate was not run. Several rules depend on tags that do not exist yet and on assumed behaviour of db.get and sensitive field marking.
